prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Generate a completely NEW painting from scratch of a medieval Sichuan embroidery workshop, for an EU5 environmental event illustration. The two input images are style references only: match their natural painterly realism, directional brushwork, convincing wood / cloth / skin materials, restrained earthy palette and soft spatial depth. Do not edit, stylize or filter a previous workshop painting.

New composition: a quiet modest timber workshop viewed diagonally into the room, a wide 16:9 full-bleed scene. One wooden rectangular embroidery frame fills the lower-middle foreground, with a single unfinished muted indigo silk panel bearing a restrained cream bird-and-flower motif. A seated woman at the left side of the frame works carefully with a fine needle and thread; across the frame an older female master demonstrates a stitch to a young adult apprentice. Three people only, ordinary period clothes, natural anatomy and believable working posture. They are integrated into the room, not portrait figures. Ensure separate and naturally positioned hands, no fused fingers, no doubled body parts.

Only a small folded sample cloth, one spool and a shallow thread basket on the adjoining bench. A plain window and an open doorway towards a softly suggested quiet courtyard admit gentle daylight. No vast mountain / river city panorama. One modest loom can be faintly suggested against the far wall but is secondary; the central topic is hands-on Sichuan embroidery, not a busy textile showroom. No hanging rows of patterned banners, countless decorative fabrics or elaborate props. The sewing frame must have a coherent structure, cloth stretched across its upper plane; the figures' hands should reach the actual embroidered surface.

Narrative: the master points at a still-incomplete part of the pattern while the apprentice listens; we can understand the craft and passing-on of skill, but the order or question being discussed is left unresolved. Moderate readable detail, breathing space between forms. Quiet concentration rather than a posed group inspecting merchandise.

Soft overcast daylight, subdued grey-brown wood, muted indigo cloth, warm grey and dusty earth clothes; modest cream highlights. Gentle contrast, readable shadows, no gold spectacle or strong rim light. Natural brushwork follows forms, not uniform stippling. No artificial impasto, embossed paint, pointillist dots, photorealistic glossy render, watercolor, ink scroll, dense ornament, captions, seals, lettering, UI, border or watermark.
